title: The Blinding Power of a Bribe

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds those who see and twists the words of the innocent." - Exodus 23:8 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God gives a piercing insight into human nature here: a bribe blinds those who see and twists the words of the righteous. Money and favours have a strange power to cloud our judgment. A gift slipped into the hand can make a clear-sighted person suddenly unable to see what is right in front of them. God warns His people to guard against this subtle corruption, because it destroys justice from the inside.

We may think of bribery as something that happens only in courtrooms or government offices, but the principle reaches into all of us. Whenever we let personal gain shape what we call true or right, we have been "bribed" in the biblical sense. The promotion we want, the approval we crave, the comfort we do not wish to lose — any of these can quietly bend our judgment and twist our honesty without a single rupee changing hands.

God calls His people to a clear-eyed integrity that cannot be bought. This is possible only when our hearts are anchored in something money cannot touch. When our security and worth rest in God rather than in what we can gain, we become free — free to see clearly, to speak honestly, and to do right even when it costs us. Ask God to keep your vision clear and your integrity unpurchasable today.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
What "bribes" — money, approval, comfort — might be quietly bending my judgment?
Where do I need my integrity to be truly unpurchasable?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, keep my eyes clear and my integrity unpurchasable. Anchor my worth in You alone, so that no gain can twist my honesty or blind me to what is right. Amen.
